source_text: In 2010, the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) issued a policy statement suggesting that a "ritual genital nick" of minimal extent might serve as a culturally sensitive compromise to discourage more severe forms of female genital cutting among immigrant families, framing it as a potential harm-reduction strategy. [83]
